resources.string: Android shows the document location; some providers cannot reveal its exact parent folder.

This format has no in-app preview. Choose Open with for Office documents and other formats.
Cannot preview. The file may have moved, be damaged, have expired access, or use an unsupported format. Try Open with.
Showing only the first 256 KB of text.
Save received images to Gallery automatically
Newly received, verified images only. Originals stay in the receive location. Manual saving is also available.
Gallery save failed. The received file is safe. Retry or check system settings.
The image stays in the receive location. You can save it to Gallery manually.

Previews run offline on this device, without uploading content or automatically fetching document resources from the internet. With automatic saving on, newly received, verified images are also copied to Pictures/LimLink in the system photo library. Originals stay in place. You can turn this off in Settings; deleting a received entry does not delete its Gallery copy. Content goes to another app only when you choose Share or Open with.

Images, PDF, video, audio and text have in-app previews. Office and other formats require Open with; support depends on the device. Images are verified and saved before copying to Gallery. Permission or export failure does not change receipt success; retry is available. Open containing location may show the system document picker. A checkmark means verified saving or recipient acknowledgement; Gallery export status is shown separately.
